diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 7505656..d2ca1a1 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,20 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+python -m pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or test with:
+
+```sh
+python -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+python -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Note: this repo does not have a test suite yet. The commands above are the
+convention to follow once `test_*.py` files are added alongside the modules.
